name: Sue Lines I will now deal with the second reading amendment circulated by One Nation. The question is that the amendment on sheet 3858 be agreed to. _One Nation's_ _circulated_ _amendment—_ Omit all words after "That", substitute "further consideration of the bills be made an order of the day for the first sitting day after amendments are circulated removing all funding for net zero measures and the administration of net zero measures". _A division having been called and the bells being rung—_ David Pocock by leave—I was just wondering if my support for (a) on that last amendment could be noted. Sue Lines On 3861? David Pocock Yes.
